novel_features.name: Activity delta since last sync
novel_features.description: See exactly what moved on your tasks since the last sync: status changes, new or removed assignees, and due-date shifts, grouped by task.
novel_features.rationale: Requires diffing two synced task snapshots in the local store. No single ClickUp API call returns a cross-task change set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this at standup or after time off instead of scrolling each task's activity feed.

novel_features.name: My-day offline triage
novel_features.description: Your open tasks across every list, sorted by due date with overdue and stuck flags, served entirely from the local store with no network.
novel_features.rationale: Spans all lists in one read against synced data; the API has no single 'everything assigned to me' endpoint and is online-only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The first command of the morning; works on a plane.

novel_features.name: Assignee workload balance
novel_features.description: Open-task count, summed time estimates, and active-timer status per team member across a space, so you can see who is overloaded before sprint planning.
novel_features.rationale: Local join of tasks, members, and time entries. ClickUp gates the equivalent workload view behind a paid Dashboard tier.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'who is overloaded' without a paid Dashboard or a manual CSV pivot.

novel_features.name: Time-in-status / cycle-time
novel_features.description: How long tasks dwell in each status, per task or rolled up per list, computed from status-change history captured during sync.
novel_features.rationale: Needs a local status-change history table built at sync time; the live API exposes current status only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Quantifies 'how long do tasks sit in review' that ClickUp only shows in paid Dashboards.

novel_features.name: Stale task detection
novel_features.description: Tasks with no update in N days, optionally filtered to a status like 'review', surfaced from the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Local time-window query over synced date_updated; no API filter returns a cross-list stale set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Find forgotten work before it rots, in one command.

novel_features.name: Dependency-aware ready set
novel_features.description: Tasks whose blockers are all closed (or, with 'blocked', the open blockers holding a task up), computed by joining tasks with their dependencies.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join across tasks, dependencies, and status that no single endpoint computes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells an agent or a person exactly what is actually ready to work on right now.

novel_features.name: Offline batch resolver
novel_features.description: Turn fuzzy human input (status name, assignee 'me' or a name, natural-language due date) into hard ClickUp IDs as JSON, with zero API calls.
novel_features.rationale: Resolves against synced statuses and members plus a local date parser, so a 200-task triage does not become hundreds of lookup requests.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets agents resolve names to IDs without burning rate-limit budget on every lookup.

narrative.headline: Every ClickUp endpoint plus a local SQLite mirror with offline full-text search and cross-task analytics no other ClickUp CLI ships.
narrative.value_prop: clickup-pp-cli matches the full ClickUp v2 API surface (tasks, lists, time tracking, goals, custom fields, webhooks and more) and adds what every other ClickUp tool lacks: a local store you can search offline and query with SQL. That local layer powers commands the web app charges for or cannot do at all, like time-in-status cycle analytics, assignee workload, and a 'what changed since yesterday' activity delta.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authenticate with a ClickUp personal API token (Settings > Apps > API Token, format pk_...). Set it once with `clickup-pp-cli auth set-token` or export CLICKUP_API_TOKEN. The token goes in the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix, matching ClickUp's scheme.

quickstart.comment: store your personal token so every command is authenticated
list your workspaces (teams) and note the id you want, the root of the hierarchy
pull your workspaces and their tasks into the local SQLite store so offline and analytics commands work
your open tasks across all lists, due in the next week, served offline
full-text search across synced tasks and comments

troubleshoots.fix: Run `clickup-pp-cli auth set-token pk_...` with a valid personal token, or check CLICKUP_API_TOKEN is exported. ClickUp personal tokens go in Authorization with no Bearer prefix.

troubleshoots.symptom: Analytics commands (time-in-status, changed-since, workload) return empty
troubleshoots.fix: Run `clickup-pp-cli sync` first; these read the local store, not the live API.
ClickUp allows 100 requests/minute per token. Sync backs off automatically; for ad-hoc loops add --limit or pause between calls.

narrative.when_to_use: Use clickup-pp-cli when you manage ClickUp work from the terminal or from an agent and want more than a thin API mirror. It is the right choice when you need offline access to your tasks, full-text search across a synced workspace, or analytics like cycle time and workload that the ClickUp web app gates behind paid Dashboards. It is also the agent-friendly option: deterministic --json/--select output, --dry-run on mutations, and an offline resolver that turns fuzzy input into IDs without extra API calls.
